sections.changelog:
0.16.0

  • Added complete Engrain/SightMap property, floorplan, and availability-qualified unit syncing.
  • Added All-In Pricing, unit-derived floorplan pricing and availability, galleries, images, amenities, apply links, scoped expenses, deposits, and pricing disclaimers.
  • Added paginated API handling and authoritative-response safeguards so failed or incomplete requests cannot erase synchronized inventory.
  • Normalized Engrain data into shared Rent Fetch fields and provider-neutral fee and total-monthly-price fields.
